title: Stunning Gameplay! - Copi Cafe Episode 52 | Cornucopias
description:
Copi Cafe  Episode  #52

Get ready for an action-packed episode of Copi Cafe as Josh and Rob take a deep dive into the world of gaming! Join them as they discuss the dedicated server for internal multiplayer testing, share exciting details about Characters and Avatars, then get ready for an exclusive game play showcase that will undoubtedly leave you craving for more.

Strap in for nearly 20 minutes in-game and be sure to set it it to 2160 (4k) resolution!

An MMORPG where player-driven economies and a thirst for adventure rule the bubbleverse. Develop your skills as a trader, artisan, or entrepreneur as you explore the Cornucopian land masses enclosed in floating domes thousands of meters high. Challenge other players to mini-games, create digital assets that you actually own, and discover the truth behind what awaits you beyond the domes

03:19 - Voting
08:59 - Characters & Avatars
16:28 - EC2 Amazon Servers
18:02 - DISCORD NEWS
24:20 - LEAK

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
